risks.risk_zh: 临时边界被误读为官方红线
risks.risk_en: Provisional boundary misread as official redline
risks.mitigation: dashed low-contrast geometry, repeated warning and full recomputation trigger

risks.risk_zh: 自动建议进入公共效果
risks.stop: disconnect model and retain staffed baseline

risks.risk_zh: 数字入口成为唯一入口
risks.risk_en: Digital interface becomes the only entrance
risks.mitigation: paper, tactile, telephone and staffed paths
risks.stop: pause digital layer while ordinary route stays open

risks.risk_zh: 跨场景画像和持续跟踪
未核史实和未授权素材进入展陈
risks.risk_en: Unverified history or uncleared assets enter display
risks.stop: remove item and retain only verified card

risks.risk_zh: 试点退出后设施无人维护
risks.mitigation: named maintenance role, budget placeholder and exit receipt

risks.risk_zh: 活动挤占日常公共空间
risks.mitigation: ordinary-first capacity rule and restoration check
risks.stop: stop event and restore daily use

risks.risk_zh: 生成媒体被误读为现状或官方效果图
risks.risk_en: Generated media misread as existing condition or official rendering
risks.mitigation: presentation_only labels, rights ledger and text-free concept media
risks.stop: remove media if provenance cannot be shown
